VeraGrid documentation

The documentation is built using sphinx.

  1. Install requirements.txt to be able to do it.

  2. Run make.py

  3. Inspect the build directory

  4. Open index.html

  5. Navigate and see if it is what you wanted.

How to build the automatic API code docs:

sphinx-apidoc -o ./rst_source/api/auto ../src/VeraGridEngine --tocfile modules

This will automatically create the files at doc/rst_source/api/auto

The build configuration is stored at conf.py
